description: This file provides functions and types for inspecting file system permissions, including POSIX and Windows ACLs, with functions for safe stat, permission checks, and formatting permission details and remediation commands.

methods.name: safeStat
methods.description: Performs a safe file system stat, returning file info or error.

methods.name: inspectPathPermissions
methods.description: Inspects permissions of a given path, considering platform-specific ACLs or POSIX modes.

methods.name: formatPermissionDetail
methods.description: Formats a string describing the permissions of a path based on its permission check info.

methods.name: formatPermissionRemediation
methods.description: Generates a command string to remediate permissions based on the permission check info.

methods.name: modeBits
methods.description: Extracts permission bits from a mode number.

methods.name: formatOctal
methods.description: Formats permission bits as an octal string.

methods.name: isWorldWritable
methods.description: Checks if permission bits indicate world-writable.

methods.name: isGroupWritable
methods.description: Checks if permission bits indicate group-writable.

methods.name: isWorldReadable
methods.description: Checks if permission bits indicate world-readable.

methods.name: isGroupReadable
methods.description: Checks if permission bits indicate group-readable.
